mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS "resourceId", d.code AS "code", d.name AS "name", di.ip AS "ip", c.code AS "capability", dev.icon AS "icon", (SELECT p.id FROM resource_node p WHERE p.id = d.parent_id AND p.kind = 'island') AS "islandId", (SELECT p.code FROM resource_node p WHERE p.id = d.parent_id AND p.kind = 'island') AS "islandCode" FROM resource_node d JOIN device_instance di ON di.resource_id = d.id AND di.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN device dev ON dev.id = di.device_model_id LEFT JOIN capability c ON c.id = dev.capability_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{param1} AND d.kind = 'device' AND (#{param2}::bigint IS NULL OR d.parent_id = #{param2}) ORDER BY d.code

SELECT DISTINCT m.method FROM device_method m JOIN device d ON d.id = m.device_model_id AND d.tenant_id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{param1} -- 三种键都认（2026-11-15 补 d.model）： -- d.code 型号池编号（如 EQ145 / P_AUTO） -- d.attr->>'device_model' 画像 id（如 carousel-extractor-generic） -- d.model 型号名字符串（如 XRobot A10LR / EL406） -- ⚠ 少了第三种：**历史型号**（旧系统迁过来的）既没有 attr.device_model， -- 而它的 code（EQ145）与 model（XRobot A10LR）又不是同一个值 -- ⇒ 三个键各查一遍都落空 ⇒ 方法集查不到 ⇒ -- 清单里 methods 是空数组 ⇒ 模拟器按**画像**校验方法集 -- ⇒ 把合法指令拒了（EC-06-0004）⇒ 节点转人工、流程暂停。 AND (d.code = #{param2} OR d.attr->>'device_model' = #{param2} OR d.model = #{param2}) ORDER BY 1

SELECT m.method AS "method", max(m.estimate_sec) AS "estimateSec" FROM device_method m JOIN device d ON d.id = m.device_model_id AND d.tenant_id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{param1} AND (d.code = #{param2} OR d.attr->>'device_model' = #{param2} OR d.model = #{param2}) AND m.estimate_sec IS NOT NULL AND m.estimate_sec > 0 GROUP BY m.method ORDER BY 1

SELECT di.id AS "deviceId", di.resource_id AS "resourceId", di.code AS "code", di.name AS "name", di.ip AS "ip", di.status::text AS "status", d.id AS "driverId", d.code AS "driverCode", d.endpoint AS "endpoint", c.code AS "capability", dev.device_type AS "deviceType", dev.model AS "model", dev.attr->>'device_model' AS "modelId" FROM device_instance di JOIN driver d ON d.id = di.driver_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN device dev ON dev.id = di.device_model_id LEFT JOIN capability c ON c.id = dev.capability_id WHERE di.tenant_id = #{param1} AND di.deleted_at IS NULL AND di.status <> 'disabled' AND d.status = 1 AND d.endpoint IS NOT NULL AND d.endpoint <> '' ORDER BY di.id

SELECT i.id AS "id", i.code AS "code", i.name AS "name", d.id AS "devId", d.code AS "devCode", d.name AS "devName", dev.model AS "model", dev.vendor AS "vendor", dev.icon AS "icon",
dev.attr::text AS "deviceAttr", c.code AS "capability", di.id AS "instanceId", di.ip AS "ip", dr.endpoint AS "driverEndpoint", dr.code AS "driverCode", (d.attr->>'pos_x')::numeric AS "posX", (d.attr->>'pos_y')::numeric AS "posY", COALESCE(ds.online, false) AS "online", COALESCE(ds.status, 'idle') AS "devStatus", ds.current_method AS "currentMethod", ds.has_plate AS "hasPlate", -- 2026-11-15：把"这台现在能不能接板/交板"的状态暴露出去。 -- 分盘式提取仪报【等待交互】后，现场要能一眼看到"交互位现在可不可用"； -- 之前这几个字段只存在于 device_state 表里，接口不出 ⇒ 现场看不见。 ds.ready_give AS "readyGive", ds.ready_take AS "readyTake", ds.last_error AS "lastError", ds.current_run_id AS "currentRunId" FROM resource_node i LEFT JOIN resource_node d ON d.parent_id = i.id AND d.kind = 'device' LEFT JOIN device_instance di ON di.resource_id = d.id AND di.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN device dev ON dev.id = di.device_model_id LEFT JOIN capability c ON c.id = dev.capability_id LEFT JOIN driver dr ON dr.id = di.driver_id AND dr.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN device_state ds ON ds.resource_id = d.id AND ds.tenant_id = i.tenant_id WHERE i.tenant_id = #{param1} AND i.kind = 'island' ORDER BY i.code, d.code

ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, device_model_id, method) WHERE scope = 'model' DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, capability_id = EXCLUDED.capability_id, param_schema = EXCLUDED.param_schema, estimate_sec = EXCLUDED.estimate_sec, timeout_sec = EXCLUDED.timeout_sec, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT d.code AS "code", d.name AS "name", d.device_type AS "deviceType", c.code AS "cap", d.icon AS "icon", d.attr->>'device_model' AS "modelId", (SELECT count(*) FROM device_instance di WHERE di.device_model_id = d.id AND di.deleted_at IS NULL) AS "deployed" FROM device d LEFT JOIN capability c ON c.id = d.capability_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY deployed DESC, d.code

WITH RECURSIVE scoped AS ( SELECT r.id FROM resource_node r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.id = #{param2} UNION SELECT r.id FROM resource_node r JOIN scoped s ON r.parent_id = s.id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM resource_node r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.id = #{param2} AND r.kind = 'island') AS "island", (SELECT count(*) FROM resource_node r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.parent_id = #{param2} AND r.kind = 'device') AS "devices", (SELECT count(*) FROM device_point dp WHERE dp.tenant_id = #{param1} AND dp.device_resource_id IN (SELECT id FROM resource_node r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.parent_id = #{param2} AND r.kind = 'device')) AS "points", (SELECT count(*) FROM node_binding nb WHERE nb.tenant_id = #{param1} AND nb.device_instance_id IN (SELECT di.id FROM device_instance di WHERE di.tenant_id = #{param1} AND di.resource_id IN (SELECT id FROM resource_node r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.parent_id = #{param2} AND r.kind = 'device'))) AS "bindings", (SELECT count(*) FROM device_pool p WHERE p.tenant_id = #{param1} AND p.island_id = #{param2}) AS "pools", (SELECT count(*) FROM workflow w WHERE w.tenant_id = #{param1} AND w.island_id = #{param2}) AS "workflows", (SELECT count(*) FROM run r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.workflow_id IN (SELECT id FROM workflow w WHERE w.tenant_id = #{param1} AND w.island_id = #{param2})) AS "runs", (SELECT count(*) FROM run_node rn WHERE rn.tenant_id = #{param1} AND rn.run_id IN (SELECT id FROM run r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.workflow_id IN (SELECT id FROM workflow w WHERE w.tenant_id = #{param1} AND w.island_id = #{param2}))) AS "runNodes", (SELECT count(*) FROM run_command rc WHERE rc.tenant_id = #{param1} AND rc.run_id IN (SELECT id FROM run r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.workflow_id IN (SELECT id FROM workflow w WHERE w.tenant_id = #{param1} AND w.island_id = #{param2}))) AS "runCommands", (SELECT count(*) FROM run_position_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = #{param1} AND s.run_id IN (SELECT id FROM run r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.workflow_id IN (SELECT id FROM workflow w WHERE w.tenant_id = #{param1} AND w.island_id = #{param2}))) AS "snapshots", (SELECT count(*) FROM device_event e WHERE e.tenant_id = #{param1} AND e.device_id IN (SELECT di.id FROM device_instance di WHERE di.tenant_id = #{param1} AND di.resource_id IN (SELECT id FROM resource_node r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.parent_id = #{param2} AND r.kind = 'device'))) AS "deviceEvents", (SELECT count(*) FROM experiment_template t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{param1} AND t.island_id = #{param2}) AS "templates", (SELECT count(*) FROM plate p WHERE p.tenant_id = #{param1} AND p.location_id IN ( SELECT id FROM resource_node r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND (r.parent_id = #{param2} OR r.parent_id IN (SELECT id FROM resource_node r2 WHERE r2.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r2.parent_id = #{param2})))) AS "plates", (SELECT count(*) FROM robot_point rp WHERE rp.tenant_id = #{param1} AND rp.island_id = #{param2}) AS "robotPoints", (SELECT count(*) FROM position_state ps WHERE ps.tenant_id = #{param1} AND ps.resource_id IN (SELECT id FROM scoped)) AS "positionStates", (SELECT count(*) FROM position_evidence pe WHERE pe.tenant_id = #{param1} AND pe.resource_id IN (SELECT id FROM scoped)) AS "positionEvidence", (SELECT count(*) FROM experiment e WHERE e.tenant_id = #{param1} AND e.island_id = #{param2}) AS "experiments",
(SELECT count(*) FROM run r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.workflow_id IN (SELECT id FROM workflow w WHERE w.tenant_id = #{param1} AND w.island_id = #{param2}) AND r.status IN ('draft','pending','planned','queued','running','paused')) AS "liveRuns",
(SELECT count(*) FROM device_state ds WHERE ds.tenant_id = #{param1} AND ds.online AND ds.resource_id IN (SELECT id FROM resource_node r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.parent_id = #{param2} AND r.kind = 'device')) AS "onlineDevices",
(SELECT count(*) FROM experiment e WHERE e.tenant_id = #{param1} AND e.workflow_id IN (SELECT id FROM workflow w WHERE w.tenant_id = #{param1} AND w.island_id = #{param2}) AND e.island_id IS NOT NULL AND e.island_id <> #{param2}) AS "foreignExperiments", (SELECT count(*) FROM experiment_template t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{param1} AND t.island_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{param2} AND t.workflow_ids && (SELECT array_agg(id) FROM workflow w WHERE w.tenant_id = #{param1} AND w.island_id = #{param2})) AS "foreignTemplates", (SELECT count(*) FROM protocol_step ps WHERE ps.pinned_resource_id IN (SELECT id FROM resource_node r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.parent_id = #{param2} AND r.kind = 'device')) AS "pinnedProtocols", (SELECT count(*) FROM consumable_lot cl WHERE cl.tenant_id = #{param1} AND (cl.location_id IN (SELECT id FROM resource_node r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.parent_id = #{param2} AND r.kind = 'device') OR cl.device_id IN (SELECT id FROM resource_node r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.parent_id = #{param2} AND r.kind = 'device'))) AS "consumableLots", (SELECT count(*) FROM reagent_lot rl WHERE rl.tenant_id = #{param1} AND (rl.location_id IN (SELECT id FROM resource_node r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.parent_id = #{param2} AND r.kind = 'device') OR rl.device_id IN (SELECT id FROM resource_node r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.parent_id = #{param2} AND r.kind = 'device'))) AS "reagentLots", (SELECT count(*) FROM schedule_item si WHERE si.tenant_id = #{param1} AND si.resource_id IN (SELECT id FROM resource_node r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.parent_id = #{param2} AND r.kind = 'device')) AS "scheduleItems", (SELECT count(*) FROM resource_booking rb WHERE rb.tenant_id = #{param1} AND rb.resource_id IN (SELECT id FROM resource_node r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.parent_id = #{param2} AND r.kind = 'device')) AS "bookings" FROM (SELECT 1) x

WITH RECURSIVE isl AS ( SELECT id, code FROM resource_node WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2} AND kind = 'island' ), scoped AS ( -- 岛 + 它的**全部后代**（沿 parent 链递归，不看 path —— -- path 可能没填；而点位节点既可能是设备的子节点，也可能是直接挂在岛下的） SELECT r.id, r.kind FROM resource_node r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.id = (SELECT id FROM isl) UNION SELECT r.id, r.kind FROM resource_node r JOIN scoped s ON r.parent_id = s.id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} ), dev AS ( SELECT id FROM scoped WHERE kind = 'device' ), pnt AS ( SELECT id FROM scoped WHERE kind <> 'device' AND id <> (SELECT id FROM isl) ), di AS ( SELECT id FROM device_instance WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND resource_id IN (SELECT id FROM dev) ), pts AS ( SELECT id FROM device_point WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND device_resource_id IN
